thread:
maria_finance: FYI AcmeHealth escalated a billing dispute for INV-67890 — claim: platform fee changed during migration addendum. Need quick reconciliation.

sam_sales: I have their note. They say it went from percent to flat; no schedule attached.

oliver_custsuccess: They expected 10% for the onboarding window. billing-bot: Invoice INV-67890 lines: ["GPU commit $100k", "Platform fee $24k", "Support Premier $4,450"], total $128,450.

maria_finance: @tara_revenueops can you confirm the amendment language?

tara_revenueops: AMND-3321 references Schedule B but the uploaded packet misses Schedule B. There's an internal doc where product ops drafted "Platform fee: flat USD 12,000 per month" but it lacks signature.

sam_sales: Sales template had placeholder {PLATFORM_FEE} — looks like someone pasted draft flat fee text into the document.

maria_finance: No executed flat fee -> default to master SOW 10% = $10k. We'll need to credit $14k.

billing-bot: Generated provisional credit CM-3344 for $14,000. Collection status set to On Hold.

maria_finance: Routing credit for CFO approval since >$10k.

oliver_custsuccess: Customer approved adjusting to 10% for this period if we credit now and will sign the amendment if sales sends final.

tara_revenueops: Legal confirms Schedule B unsigned = not binding. Approvals granted.

maria_finance: Applied credit and issued corrected invoice INV-67890-R1. Marking dispute resolved.
